tips.tired_of_typing_keep_going: Tired of typing "keep going"? Just send a '.' instead
tips.btw_side_question: You can use /btw to ask a side question
tips.tan_background_agent: Use /tan to branch the current conversation to a background agent
tips.ctrl_d_exit: Ctrl+D exits, but your draft is saved!
tips.ompt_stats: Use `omp stats` to see which model you use most
tips.task_isolation: Try task isolation to create a CoW worktree
tips.completion_nested: Need a cheap nested model call? Use `completion(x...)`. Got lots of tasks? Let clanker handle it!
tips.spaghetti_code: Code looking like spaghetti? Try /omfg to vent about it
tips.multi_session: Did you know? Each kitty/tmux/cmux/zellij/wezterm pane has its own session — `omp -c` auto-resumes the right one
tips.ultrathink: Add `ultrathink` to a message for deeper multi-step reasoning — rainbow glow while typing
tips.orchestrate: Say `orchestrate` in a message to drive multi-stage parallel subagent tasks — glow while typing
tips.workflowz: Say `workflowz` in a message to drive eval tasks with parallel subagents — glow while typing
tips.multi_account: Log into multiple accounts on the same provider — `/login` again — omp auto-load-balances
tips.auth_broker: Run `omp auth-broker serve` once, all machines pull live tokens — refresh keys never leave the host; `omp auth-gateway` as an OpenAI-compatible proxy
tips.switch_provider: Press alt+p (or /switch) to switch providers, ctrl+p to cycle role models
tips.ctrl_r_history: Press ctrl+r to search your prompt history and reuse previous messages
tips.force_read: `/force read` makes the next turn use only the read tool, useful when the model keeps picking wrong
tips.copy_code: `/copy code` copies the last code block to clipboard — `/copy cmd` copies the last shell/python command
tips.shake: `/shake` removes large tool results from context to free tokens, without a full /compact — `/shake images` removes only images
tips.collab: Live collaboration: `/collab` shares your session via end-to-end encrypted relay — teammates run `/join <link>` to watch tool calls and prompt the agent
tips.inspect_transcript: Press ← ← to drill into a running or completed agent, inspect its tool calls and conversation
tips.usage_reset: Hit Codex rate limit? `/usage reset` uses saved reset credits to restore quota immediately
tips.pi_dialect: No native tool_calling? Reasoning provider parsing errors? Set `PI_DIALECT=glm|kimi|anthropic…` to handle it locally!
tips.advisor: Enable `/advisor` to attach a second model that reviews each turn and quietly injects suggestions [NEW]
